headline: KCR @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is KCR 3.53 at TEX 4.88, with a projected total of 8.41. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward KCR: KCR moved +0.74 runs while TEX moved +0.34, changing the projected margin by +0.40 runs. The projected total climbed +1.09, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Michael Wacha has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Jung, Maikel Garcia, Bobby Witt Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Justin Foscue, Michael Massey because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
